core_obligations: Reduce to injectivity of u by checking N/IN -> M/IM for all ideals and replacing A by A/I (proof lines 7310-7316).
For a nonzero x in the kernel, localise at a weakly associated prime and find y with support in the closed fibre (proof lines 7318-7327).
Choose the pure spreadout ideal I with I^n y = 0, use flatness to rewrite Ann_M(I^n), and deduce the contradiction from part (2) of the pure spreadout properties lemma (proof lines 7329-7341).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to injectivity of u (proof lines 7310-7316).
The weakly associated prime and the element y (proof lines 7318-7327).
The pure spreadout ideal and the tensor computation (proof lines 7329-7341).
difficulty_reason: In equation labelled equation-star the lemma assumes N is A-flat, M is a flat A-module and u : N -> M is an A-module map with u otimes id_{kappa(p)} injective for every prime p, and concludes that u is A-universally injective (statement lines 7302-7308). By Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-check-universally-injective-into-flat it suffices to check injectivity of N/IN -> M/IM for every ideal I, and replacing A by A/I reduces this to injectivity of u (proof lines 7310-7316). For that, the proof takes a nonzero x in the kernel of u, chooses a weakly associated prime p of the module Ax by Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-weakly-ass-zero, passes to the localisation at p and picks a nonzero y in Ax whose annihilator has radical the maximal ideal by Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-weakly-ass-local, so that the support of y lies in the closed fibre of Spec(S^{-1}B) -> Spec(A) (proof lines 7318-7327). Choosing a finitely generated ideal I inside the maximal ideal so that there is a pure spreadout over A/I by Lemma labelled lemma-find-pure-spreadout, one has I^n y = 0, and flatness gives Ann_M(I^n) = Ann_A(I^n) otimes_R N; the desired contradiction therefore follows once Ann_A(I^n) otimes_R N -> Ann_A(I^n) otimes_R M is injective, which since Ann_A(I^n) is annihilated by I^n and both modules are flat reduces to the injectivity of Q otimes_A N -> Q otimes_A M for every A-module Q annihilated by I, and that is exactly Lemma labelled lemma-properties-pure-spreadout part (2) (proof lines 7329-7341). Producing the pure spreadout ideal through a weakly associated prime and turning the counterexample into a tensor computation is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
